title: caps-scout
name: caps-scout
description: Host capability discovery for Checkmk. An agent plugin detects which engines run on a host (databases, web and application servers, containers, virtualization, clustering, backup, messaging, and more) and reports each one as a host label under caps/, so you can see which Checkmk plugins are worth installing there. A Checkmk-side SNMP section also identifies 117 SNMP device families, such as Cisco, Juniper, Fortinet and APC, as caps/snmp/ labels, reusing the host's existing SNMP credentials. A Capabilities Scout service lists every detected capability with its logo and an Add rule link to the matching bakery rule, and a bakery rule deploys the agent plugin itself.
author: Andrea Vaccaro <andrea.vaccaro@gmail.com>
